exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) adherence to Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations
Gestational weight gain (GWG) adherence to Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) recommendations
cohort: The study included 300 women with class III obesity who delivered a singleton at the University Hospital of Reims, France.
finding: Non-excessive gestational weight gain was associated with shorter labor, reduced postpartum hemorrhage, lower birthweight, and decreased risk of LGA neonates, though it did not significantly affect the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Non-excessive gestational weight gain according to IOM and JAMA recommendations was not significantly associated with the mode of delivery.
